overview.projectName: AgriFlow — Smart Irrigation & Soil Moisture Automation Controller
overview.summary: AgriFlow is an automated, weather-resilient agricultural IoT controller designed to continuously measure soil dielectric permittivity and atmospheric vapor-pressure deficit (VPD) to actuate high-pressure drip solenoid valves.
overview.problemStatement: Over-irrigation in greenhouse crops wastes up to 40% of fresh water while leaching essential soil nutrients; manual valve scheduling cannot react to real-time microclimate evaporation changes.
goals: Continuously monitor root-zone volumetric water content (VWC)
Trigger 12V DC brass solenoid valve pulses precisely when moisture drops below 35%
Display real-time soil VWC, temperature, and pump status on an outdoor-readable 16x2 LCD
scope: Capacitive soil moisture sensing v1.2 with corrosion-resistant probe geometry
DHT22 high-accuracy temperature and relative humidity sensing
ESP32 dual-core threshold controller and non-volatile calibration storage
Optocoupled 5V dual-channel relay module driving a 12V DC solenoid valve
IP67 weatherproof sealed junction box with PG7 cable glands
outOfScope: Cloud telemetry or remote cellular modem streaming
Multi-zone chemical fertilizer injection dosing pump

features.name: Dielectric Volumetric Water Content Sensing
features.description: Samples analog output from capacitive soil probe with 12-bit ADC precision to determine real-time soil hydration.

features.name: Atmospheric Vapor-Pressure Deficit Tracking
features.description: Monitors ambient greenhouse temperature and relative humidity with DHT22 for microclimate evapotranspiration calculations.

features.name: Pulsed Solenoid Valve Drip Control
features.description: Switches an isolated 10A optocoupled relay to open a 12V DC brass solenoid water valve for regulated 15-minute soak cycles.

features.name: Outdoor Backlit LCD Status Display
features.description: Renders live soil moisture percentage, air temperature, valve state, and last irrigation timestamp on a 16x2 character screen.

roles.name: Farm Irrigation Operator
roles.description: Supervises crop zone hydration thresholds and performs manual bypass irrigation tests.

requirements.description: System shall sample soil moisture at 10-second intervals with +/- 2% volumetric water content accuracy.
Solenoid valve activation shall feature a hardware watchdog to prevent overflow flooding if MCU freezes.
acceptanceCriteria: Maximum continuous open time strictly capped at 20 minutes

requirements.description: Controller casing must withstand 100% humidity and direct water spray in greenhouse environments.
acceptanceCriteria: IP67 rated enclosure with silicone seal gasket
Cable entries sealed via waterproof glands

teamRoles.responsibility: Schematic design, breadboard circuit assembly, component sourcing, and enclosure modeling
ESP32 C++/Arduino firmware, ADC filtering algorithms, and I2C display drivers

estimatedCost.basis: Prototyping components, breadboard, custom 3D printed enclosure, and 5V power adapter.
estimatedCost.disclaimer: Approximate estimate based on the supplied requirements.

resources.name: Electronics Prototyping Bench
resources.purpose: Soldering, breadboarding, and digital multimeter testing

hardware.workingPrinciple: Frequency-domain capacitive probe measures changes in soil dielectric permittivity caused by water content. When the analog reading falls below the 35% threshold, ESP32 GPIO4 trips an optoisolated relay, opening a 12V DC brass solenoid valve to deliver pulsed drip hydration.

components.name: ESP32 DevKit V1 Microcontroller
components.purpose: Dual-core processor executing sensor sampling loop, relay control state machine, and I2C LCD driver
components.specification: ESP-WROOM-32, 240MHz Xtensa Dual-Core, 12-bit ADC, 520KB SRAM, 3.3V Logic

components.name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Probe v1.2
components.purpose: Corrosion-resistant dielectric root-zone volumetric water content sensor
components.specification: Analog voltage 0-3.0V linear output, 3.3V-5V operating voltage, conformal coated probe

components.name: DHT22 High-Precision Temperature & Humidity Sensor
components.purpose: Greenhouse ambient temperature and relative humidity tracking for VPD calculations
components.specification: -40 to 80C (+/-0.5C), 0 to 100% RH (+/-2% RH), digital single-bus protocol

components.name: 5V Dual-Channel Optocoupled Relay Module
components.purpose: Electrically isolated switching for 12V DC solenoid valve power circuit
components.specification: 10A @ 250VAC / 30VDC contacts, PC817 optocoupler isolation, active LOW trigger

components.name: 12V DC 1/2-Inch Brass Solenoid Water Valve
components.purpose: Normally closed electromechanical valve controlling pressurized drip irrigation line
components.specification: 12V DC, 0.02 - 0.8 MPa operating pressure, 1/2-inch NPT threaded brass body

components.name: 16x2 Character I2C LCD Display Module
components.purpose: High-contrast outdoor-readable status readout showing live VWC and pump status
components.specification: 16 columns x 2 rows, PCF8574 I2C backpack (default address 0x27), yellow-green backlight

components.name: 12V 2A DC Power Adapter with Step-Down Buck Converter
components.purpose: Supplies 12V DC for solenoid valve and steps down to clean 5V DC for ESP32 and relay logic
components.specification: Input 100-240VAC; Output 12VDC 2A barrel jack; onboard LM2596 5V 3A step-down regulator

components.name: 8-Position Heavy-Duty Screw Barrier Terminal Block
components.purpose: Secure field wiring terminals for sensor leads, valve cables, and DC power input
components.specification: Pitch 8.25mm, 15A 300V rating, zinc-plated steel screws with transparent protective cover

controllers: ESP32 DevKit V1 240MHz Dual-Core with 12-bit ADC

roadmap.title: Phase 1: Soil & Climate Sensor Calibration
roadmap.description: Wire capacitive probe and DHT22 to ESP32 ADC and calibrate dry/wet soil points.
tasks: Calibrate capacitive probe in air (0%) and submerged water (100%)
Implement moving-average ADC filter on ESP32 GPIO36
Verify DHT22 1-wire timing and vapor pressure calculations
completionCriteria: Live soil volumetric water content updates stably on serial monitor

roadmap.title: Phase 2: Relay & Solenoid Valve Control Loop
roadmap.description: Integrate 5V relay module with 12V solenoid valve and hardware safety timeout.
tasks: Wire optocoupled relay to ESP32 GPIO4 with flyback protection
Connect 16x2 I2C LCD for real-time field status display
completionCriteria: Valve reliably triggers at <35% soil moisture and closes at >65%

roadmap.title: Phase 3: Weatherproof Enclosure & Field Deployment
roadmap.description: Mount assembly inside IP67 sealed box with PG7 cable glands and perform soak testing.
tasks: Mount ESP32, relay, and buck converter on DIN/standoff plate
Seal cable entries using PG7 waterproof glands
Conduct continuous 48-hour automated irrigation stress test
completionCriteria: Controller operates autonomously under water spray exposure without leak

assumptions.description: A continuous 12V DC power source or mains adapter is available near the irrigation manifold.
assumptions.reason: High-pressure solenoid valve requires 12V DC coil excitation.

openQuestions.question: What is the static water line pressure available at the drip irrigation inlet manifold?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Direct-acting vs pilot-operated solenoid valves require specific minimum line pressure (0.02 MPa).

risks.title: Sensor Drift During Initial Heating
risks.mitigation: Include software lockout requiring 24 hours of burn-in heating before saving baseline calibration.

risks.title: Sensor Poisoning from Aerosols
risks.mitigation: Clearly label enclosure warnings against using silicone adhesives, hairspray, or VOC cleaners near unit.

recommendations.title: LiPo Battery Backup with Charger IC
recommendations.description: Consider adding a single-cell LiPo battery and TP4056 charging IC for 2-hour backup during power outages.
